newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Luka H1 net profit down.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Luka H1 net profit down.

text.p: Slovenian port Luka Koper said on Friday net profit in the first half fell to 762.6 million tolars ($4.6 million) from 988.1 million the previous year.
Tracing the decline to high investment costs, the firm forecast full-year earnings would still exceed last year's 1.34 billion Austrian schillings ($103 million) net.

"The profit was down mainly due to higher investment expenses in the first half but we expect our profit at the end of the year to be above last year's figure," said Mirko Pavsic, a member of Luka's management.
Revenues in the first half rose to 4.38 billion tolars from 3.97 billion in the same period of 1996.
Pavsic said revenues should reach 8.3 billion tolars by the end of 1997, up from 8.1 billion in 1996.

Cargo traffic was expected to increase to seven million tonnes from 6.5 million tonnes last year. Pavsic said the biggest increases were in cargo traffic to and from Austria, Hungary and the Czech Republic. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($ = 167.5 Slovenian Tolars) ($ = 12.98 Austrian Schillings)
